append.description: Add an item to the end of a list.
append.name: append

parameters.description: The list to add the item to.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The item to add. A list is added as a single item.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: The list with the item added at the end.

chunk.description: Split a list into smaller lists of a set size, for an app that takes so many items at a time. Loop over the batches to send each one.
chunk.name: chunk

parameters.description: The list to split.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: How many items each batch holds. The last may hold fewer.
parameters.name: size

returns.description: The batches, each a list, in the original order.

combine_by_position.description: Pair up two lists item by item, the first with the first and the second with the second, like names with their email addresses. Records are merged; other items are put under a name of your choosing.
combine_by_position.name: combine_by_position

parameters.description: The list whose items come first in each pair.
parameters.name: first

parameters.description: The list to pair with it. Where one list is longer, its extra items are kept on their own.
parameters.name: second

parameters.description: The field to put an item of the first list under when it isn't a record, like Name. Leave empty for first.
parameters.name: first_field

parameters.description: The field to put an item of the second list under when it isn't a record, like Email. Leave empty for second.
parameters.name: second_field

returns.description: One record for each position, holding both lists' items there.

compare_lists.description: Find what two lists have in common and where they differ: what is only in the first, only in the second, in both, and, for records matched by a field, which ones changed. Handy for keeping two apps in sync.
compare_lists.name: compare_lists

parameters.description: One list, like the rows of a spreadsheet.
parameters.name: first

parameters.description: The list to compare it with, like an app's contacts.
parameters.name: second

parameters.description: For lists of records, the field that says two records are the same one, like Email or ID. Letter case and spaces don't matter. Leave empty to compare whole items.
parameters.name: field

returns.description: Four lists: only_in_first, only_in_second, in_both (items from the first list), and changed: each matching pair holding a different value in a field both have, as first, second and the names of the fields that differ.

changed.description: Records in both with a different value in a field both have, each as first, second and fields.

in_both.description: Items both lists have, as the first list holds them.

only_in_first.description: Items only the first list has.

only_in_second.description: Items only the second list has.

count_unique.description: Count how many different values a list holds, or how many different values one field takes, like how many customers placed the orders. Blanks don't count.
count_unique.name: count_unique

parameters.description: The list, or list of records, to count.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: For a list of records, the field to count the different values of, like Customer email. Letter case and spaces don't matter.
parameters.name: field

returns.description: How many different values there are.

create_list.description: Create a list by entering its items one by one.
create_list.name: create_list

parameters.description: The items to put in the list, in order.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The new list, with the items in the order entered.

edit_record.description: Add or change fields, keep or remove some, rename them, or merge in another record. Given a list, like spreadsheet rows, it edits every row: Full name can be each row's first and last name together.
edit_record.name: edit_record

parameters.description: The record, or list of records, to edit.
parameters.name: record

parameters.description: How to change the record.
parameters.name: edit

parameters.description: The names of the fields, like Name and Email. Use dots to reach inside, like address.city.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Each field's current name, and the name to give it.
parameters.name: renames

parameters.description: Its fields are added; where both records have a field, its value is the one kept.
parameters.name: other

parameters.description: Each field's name and its value, worked out for each record in turn. Refer to the record as “item”: Full name can be item.first and item.last joined by a space.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The edited record, or the list of edited records when a list was given.

filter.description: Keep only the items in a list that match a condition, and return them as a new list. Build the condition the same way as an “If” step, referring to the current item as “item”.
filter.name: filter

parameters.description: The list to filter. The condition reads each item in turn as item.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: Only items for which this is true are kept. Refer to the current item as “item” (for example, item.price is greater than 100).
parameters.name: condition

returns.description: The items that meet the condition, in their original order.

first.description: Get the first item of a list. If the list is empty, returns an empty list (shown as “Empty list”).
first.name: first

parameters.description: The list to take the first item from.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The first item in the list, of whatever type it is, or an empty list if the list has no items.

group_by.description: Sort a list of records into groups that share the same value in one field, or several, such as each owner's tasks. Each group has a key (the shared value), its items, a count, and any figures you ask for, like each rep's total sales. Text matches ignoring case and spaces; records with a blank value are kept together in a group with a blank key.
group_by.name: group_by

parameters.description: The list of records (objects) to group.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The name of the field or column whose value decides the group, for example Owner email.
parameters.name: field

parameters.description: A figure for each group beside its count, like the total sales for each rep. It is added to each group under its name: total, average, min or max.
parameters.name: summary

parameters.description: The field holding the numbers, for example Amount.
parameters.name: of_field

parameters.description: More fields that must also match for records to share a group, like Region and then Product. The group's key joins their values, and its keys field lists each one.
parameters.name: then_by

parameters.description: Figures of your own for each group, each with a name and what it is, like Revenue: total of amount, Customers: count unique of email, or Reps: join of rep. A figure is the total, average, min, max, count unique, list or join of a field.
parameters.name: summaries

returns.description: One group for each distinct value of the field, in the order the values first appear.

count.description: How many records are in the group.

items.description: The group's records, in their original order.

key.description: The value this group's records share, or empty text for records with no value.

keys.description: Grouping by more than one field, each field's value, in order.

total.description: With The total chosen, the field's total for the group (likewise average, min or max).

index_of.description: Find where an item appears in a list. Returns -1 if it is not found.
index_of.name: index_of

parameters.description: The list to search.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The item to look for. It must match an item exactly.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: The position of the first matching item, counting from 0, or -1 if the item is not in the list.

insert.description: Add an item at a specific position in a list.
insert.name: insert

parameters.description: The list to insert the item into.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: 0 is the first place, and -1 puts the item last.
parameters.name: index

parameters.description: The item to insert.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: The list with the item inserted at the position given.

join_records.description: Add the fields of the matching record in a second list to each record, like a spreadsheet lookup (VLOOKUP): each order gets its customer's name and plan, matched by email.
join_records.name: join_records

parameters.description: The records to add fields to, like orders.
parameters.name: first

parameters.description: The records to take the fields from, like customers.
parameters.name: second

parameters.description: The field the records share, like Email. Letter case and spaces don't matter.
parameters.name: field

parameters.description: When the second list names it differently, like Customer email. Leave empty when the name is the same.
parameters.name: other_field

parameters.description: Keep records that have no match as they are, or leave them out.
parameters.name: keep

returns.description: The records, each with the matching record's fields added. A field both records have keeps the first record's value unless it is blank.

last.description: Get the last item of a list. If the list is empty, returns an empty list (shown as “Empty list”).
last.name: last

parameters.description: The list to take the last item from.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The last item in the list, of whatever type it is, or an empty list if the list has no items.

length.description: Count how many items are in a list.
length.name: length

parameters.description: The list to count the items of.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The number of items in the list.

list_contains.description: Check whether a list includes a specific item.
list_contains.name: list_contains

parameters.description: The list to search.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The item to look for. It must match an item exactly.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: Whether the list includes the item.

make_record.description: Turn a list of name and value pairs, like form answers or custom fields, into one record with a field for each name.
make_record.display_name: Make a record from a list
make_record.name: make_record

parameters.description: Records that each hold a field's name and its value, like those “List a record's fields” makes.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The field of each pair holding the name. Leave empty for name.
parameters.name: name_field

parameters.description: The field of each pair holding the value. Leave empty for value.
parameters.name: value_field

returns.description: A record with a field for each pair. Where a name repeats, the last value is kept.

merge.description: Merge two lists into one, keeping the items of the first list followed by the items of the second. Leave the second list out to merge the lists inside one list into a single list (flatten).
merge.name: merge

parameters.description: The list whose items come first.
parameters.name: first

parameters.description: The list whose items come after the first list's. Leave it empty when the first list holds lists to merge into one, like the results a loop gathered.
parameters.name: second

returns.description: One list: the first list's items followed by the second list's.

pluck.description: Turn a list of records (spreadsheet rows, orders) into a list of one field's values, such as every row's Amount, so you can total, average or join them.
pluck.display_name: Get one field from every item
pluck.name: pluck

parameters.description: The list of records (objects), such as spreadsheet rows or an earlier step's results.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The name of the field or column to take from every record, for example Amount.
parameters.name: field

returns.description: The field's value from each record, in the same order, with null where a record has no value for it.

record_fields.description: Turn a record into a list: its field names, its values, or a name and value pair for each field, to loop over or show. “Make a record from a list” turns pairs back into a record.
record_fields.name: record_fields

parameters.description: The record whose fields to list.
parameters.name: record

parameters.description: What to list for each field.
parameters.name: part

returns.description: One item for each field, in the record's order: the name, the value, or a record of name and value.

remove_at.description: Remove the item at a specific position in a list.
remove_at.display_str_template: Remove the item at position {1} from {0}
remove_at.name: remove_at

parameters.description: The list to remove the item from.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: 0 is the first item, and -1 is the last.
parameters.name: index

returns.description: The list without the item at the position given.

remove_duplicates.description: Remove repeated items from a list, or records that repeat a field, like two rows for one email address. Can also remove empty items.
remove_duplicates.name: remove_duplicates

parameters.description: The list to remove repeated items from.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: For a list of records, the field that makes two records the same, like Email. The first of each is kept. Letter case and spaces don't matter. Leave empty to compare whole items.
parameters.name: field

parameters.description: Keep empty items, or remove them too.
parameters.name: remove_empty

returns.description: The list with repeated items removed, keeping the first of each.

remove_item.description: Remove an item from a list wherever it appears.
remove_item.name: remove_item

parameters.description: The list to remove the item from.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The item to remove. Every copy of it is removed.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: The list without the item.

reverse.description: Reverse the order of items in a list.
reverse.name: reverse

parameters.description: The list to reverse.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The list's items in reverse order.

shuffle.description: Put the items of a list in a random order. Returns all of the items, just reordered.
shuffle.name: shuffle

parameters.description: The list to shuffle.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The list's items in a random order.

slice.description: Take a section of a list, such as the first five items or the last three.
slice.name: slice

parameters.description: The list to take a section of.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: This item is included. Use a negative number to count from the end (-1 is the last item).
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: This item is not included. Leave blank to go through the end of the list. Use a negative number to count from the end (-1 is the last item).
parameters.name: end

returns.description: The items from the start position up to, but not including, the end position.

sort.description: Sort a list in ascending (first/smallest to last/largest) or descending (last/largest to first/smallest) order. Records can be sorted by one field, then by more, like by Last name and then First name.
sort.name: sort

parameters.description: The list to sort. Numbers, and text that holds a number, sort by value, and dates sort by date.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The order to sort in.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: For a list of records, the field to sort them by, like Amount or Created. Records without it go last.
parameters.name: field

parameters.description: More fields to sort records by when the first is the same, in order, each ascending or descending: for Last name first, First name ascending.
parameters.name: then_by

returns.description: The list's items sorted in ascending or descending order.

description: Count, sort, combine, and clean up lists and records.
